notes.title: STRANGA SALES!
notes.content:

notes.title: Small patch fixing the password system
notes.content: Hello everyone this is just a small patch for the Portuguese language, it was crashing the password system. All is good and has now been fixed :)

notes.title: Phone patch #3
notes.content:
Hopefully, this time's a winner! 

Fixed phones for all languages and shouldn't crash save files, it is recommended to reload a save before you encounter Maggie though to test properly.

notes.title: 1.6 Patch - Please Read!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, another quick update here:

- Fixed some Italian translated lines and dialogue options looking out of place as well as Vyse's last 
   option missing
- Fixed missing Chinese translated lines
- Added fixed Portuguese translation
- Added a wait until key/button press to the how to play screen (once you hear the indicator you can 
   press a key to start the game)

notes.title: Phone patch #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

This is just a small patch to fix a new issue with calling Maggie at the motel. Should now be fixed and should work with your current save file, my apologies for the innconvioenence.

notes.title: Italian Language Added + Small bug fixes.
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
